english.title: Keeper fail to comply with notice requiring isolation of bovine animals
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of bovine animals and been served with a notice requiring such bovine animals as were specified in the notice to be isolated from other animals to the extent specified, without lawful authority or excuse, failed to comply with that notice in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 16(a) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
